Class ShopManager

java.lang.Object
game.ui.ShopManager
public class ShopManager extends Object
Manages the player's economy and inventory state. Acts as the bridge between the logical PlayerBank and the visual Shop/Inventory UI, handling purchases, inventory consumption, and UI synchronization.

      public ShopManager(PlayerBank bank, javafx.scene.control.Label moneyLabel, Function<MachineType, javafx.scene.image.Image> imageLookup, Runnable onStateChange)
      Initializes the shop manager with references to the player's bank and UI callbacks.
      Parameters:
      bank - The logical bank handling the player's currency.
      moneyLabel - The UI label displaying the current balance.
      imageLookup - Function to retrieve images for inventory tiles.
      onStateChange - Callback triggered whenever inventory or balance updates occur.

    • attemptBuy

      public void attemptBuy(MachineType type)
      Attempts to purchase one unit of the specified machine. Deducts currency and adds to inventory if funds are sufficient.
      Parameters:
      type - The machine type to purchase.

    • consumeFromInventory

      public void consumeFromInventory(MachineType type)
      Deducts one unit of the specified machine type from the player's inventory. Called when a machine is successfully placed on the grid.
      Parameters:
      type - The machine type to consume.

    • returnToInventory

      public void returnToInventory(MachineType type)
      Returns one unit of type to the player's inventory. Called when a placed machine is removed from the grid. If this is somehow the first time the type is seen, its tile is also revealed.

      Returns:

      public int getInventoryCount(MachineType type)

    • refreshUI

      public void refreshUI()
      Forces an immediate visual update of the bank balance label and inventory slot quantities. Triggers the external state change callback to update dependent UI elements.
